The total volume of oxygen evolved at STP during the entire process is _____ mL[cite: 4]. (Nearest integer)
[Given: Molar mass of $\text{Cu} = 63.54\text{ g mol}^{-1}$, Molar mass of $\text{O}_2 = 32\text{ g mol}^{-1}$, Faraday Constant $= 96500\text{ C mol}^{-1}$, Molar volume at $\text{STP} = 22.4\text{ L}$][cite: 4]
